assessment: The official Bihar Department of Revenue and Land Reforms lists Bhu-Naksha and Revenue Maps among its services. Its Bhu-Naksha viewer could not be fetched in the web review; the official statewide RoR portal and Bhojpur district office reference support jurisdiction context, but no selected Arrah mouza/village or coordinate-level map extent was verified. Record-of-rights forms may contain personal data and were not queried.
registryAssessment: Bihar’s official land-records program includes parcel mapping and the relevant district is Bhojpur/Arrah, but the WUP point’s revenue village and anonymous map coverage remain unverified.
